# Blood pudding

Type: Food | Internal ID: BloodPudding | Source: Cauldron, (level 4) | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Thistle x2, Bloodbag x2, Barley flour x4 | Max Health: 25 | Max Stamina: 75 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 2 hp/tick

# Introduction

Blood pudding is a Plains-tier food.

## Recipe

Blood pudding is produced at a level 4 Cauldron with:
• 2 Thistle
• 2 Bloodbag
• 4 Barley flour

## Notes

• Blood pudding provides the highest stamina gain in the Plains at 75.
